mekayis.metin: (شَمَخَ) الشِّينُ وَالْمِيمُ وَالْخَاءُ أَصْلٌ صَحِيحٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى تَعَظُّمٍ وَارْتِفَاعٍ. يُقَالُ جَبَلٌ شَامِخٌ، أَيْ عَالٍ. وَشَمَخَ فُلَانٌ بِأَنْفِهِ، وَذَلِكَ إِذَا تَعَظَّمَ فِي نَفْسِهِ. وَشَمْخٌ: اسْمُ رَجُلٍ.

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Uncertain, but seemingly native to the Arabian peninsula; attested in early pre-Islamic inscriptions. Related to the root ش م خ (š m ḵ) meaning "to be lofty", "towering above the rest", "elevated", "coming forth from good stock or roots", and the root ش م ر (š m r) meaning "to be raised up", "to be tucked up", "to be contracted or drawn together together", "to be held together or bunched", "to cut or harvest dates from a tree", "to be fully grown or ready".
g: bundle, bunch, cluster especially one that hangs separate from the rest

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: شَامِخ • (šāmiḵ) (feminine شَامِخَة (šāmiḵa), common plural شَوَامِخ (šawāmiḵ), masculine plural شَامِخُون (šāmiḵūn) or شُمَّخ (šummaḵ), feminine plural شَامِخَات (šāmiḵāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Derived from the active participle of شَمَخَ (šamaḵa).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: تَشَامَخَ • (tašāmaḵa) VI (non-past يَتَشَامَخُ (yatašāmaḵu), verbal noun تَشَامُخ (tašāmuḵ))
g: to be high, tall (of a mountain)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تَشَامَخِي • (tašāmaḵī) (form VI) /ta.ʃaː.ma.xiː/
# second-person feminine singular imperative of تَشَامَخَ (tašāmaḵa)
